_comment: The governor's knobs. Only the owner edits this file; no agent does (the Edit/Write deny rules and the Bash gate enforce it). A missing, corrupt or non-positive daily_usd / daily_turns counts as SPENT (there is no default): unattended runs refuse to start. daily_usd / daily_turns are the circuit breaker for UNATTENDED runs (summed from agents/state/costs.tsv by agents/bin/tick); attended sessions are not limited.
_tick_mode: propose = the tick reads, verifies and writes the brief with what it WOULD close/fix/finish/open, and does none of it. act = the loop runs for real, under the WIP limit and the ceiling. Flip to act only after you have read a week of propose briefs.
_tick_push: true = the tick runs `git push` after committing its state. Default false: commits stay local.
_claude_args: claude_args is NOT read from this file any more. Set HATCHERY_CLAUDE_ARGS in the systemd unit or cron line (e.g. --permission-mode acceptEdits). Headless runs cannot answer permission prompts: allow the read-only commands and the specific scripts the tick needs BY NAME in .claude/settings.json (permissions.allow), e.g. Bash(agents/bin/tick senses), Bash(agents/bin/drift:*), Bash(agents/bin/act:*) - not agents/bin/*. The tick refuses flags that switch off the hooks (--settings, --setting-sources, --mcp-config, --plugin-dir, --add-dir, --allowedTools, --bare), --dangerously-*, and bypassPermissions unless the unit sets HATCHERY_ALLOW_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 (not recommended). It also refuses to run while this file, agents/bin, agents/prompts or guard.conf differ from the last commit: edit them yourself, then commit.
_claude_bin_and_notify: claude_bin and notify_cmd are NOT read from this file (an agent that could edit it could choose what runs). Set HATCHERY_CLAUDE_BIN (default: claude) and HATCHERY_NOTIFY_CMD (default: none; a command called as: <cmd> "<title>" "<body>", which must only ever reach you) in the systemd unit or cron line - see agents/systemd/. Any claude_bin / notify_cmd key left here is ignored.
_size_caps: Bytes. rehydrate prints OVER CAP when a file passes its cap; run `agents/bin/archive-state` (dry run) and then --apply to shrink overlord.md losslessly.
